hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: Bonding-curve hook for tokenized stock launches. Each pool has a fixed swap fee (0–5%) set at launch, split among creator, a bid wall, and a platform treasury. The bid wall accumulates its share of quote-token fees and places single-sided liquidity just below spot price; tokens acquired by the wall are permanently sequestered. External liquidity additions are blocked until the pool graduates.
